headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Marcus Semien leading the offense. Semien hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Yohan Ramírez pitched 3.1 scoreless innings in relief.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners have also placed Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. Other teams have suffered similar losses, including the Minnesota Twins with Joe Ryan, the Cleveland Guardians with Slade Cecconi, the Chicago White Sox with Chris Murphy and Joey Bart, and the Toronto Blue Jays with Luis Urías.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that was finalized on August 5, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Marcus Semien leading the offense. Semien hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Yohan Ramírez pitched 3.1 scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Phillies in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Lazaro Estrada earning the win and Tyler Rogers securing the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 3-5 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Daylen Lile leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dropped a 2-3 decision to the New York Yankees in their latest matchup. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tyler Mahle pitched 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status on the injured list is a result of a recent injury.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that was finalized on August 5, 2026.
